I miss the crashdummy minigames, though.

Early Review
"I am old flatout fan, Bugbear nailed FlatOut 2, I so wanted this game to be its successor however the posts are correct.
this game with so moch potential had been neglected and promises of great things turned into a lack luster hollow shell.
I bought this title the day it launched and they haven't even been able to give us the free backer car bonus yet. This is a stalled endevour that has done nothing but take buyers money and produced nothing in return but and unfinished boon doggle.
Shame on you BugBear"

Re-Reviewed Dec 2017
"As I have stated , I am a long time Fan of BugBear and the legends they produced, Flatout and Flatout 2.
This re-tooling of the genre is gaining some polish and Playability, I am in for a penny and in for a pound with this game and I want it to succeed, keep working on it guys, its getting there.
Also any new on the events/sports, like the curling , etc.. would be nice"

I recommend this game, it is finally playable and getting damned good."

I don't ever write reviews but this one really deserves it. A game that I was initially hyped for, only to disappoint me early on in its lifecycle. But god damn this game has risen from the ashes of it's early access beginnings and become one of my favorite racing games of all time.

The driving is a perfect blend of arcade and realism, there is a nice variety and amount of vehicles, the car damage physics are fantastic, the campaign mode with bonus objectives adds more to what would be just fun races, and the specialty events are hilarious and chaotic. The added licensed music with 1.0 release is also pretty good.

If I had one complaint about this game, it would be that I wish there was more customization; while there is a decent amount, it's not huge. Aside from this I really can't think of anything else I don't like.

Great job Bugbear on making the only early access title that has delivered for me thus far. Now finish Stuntfest.
runs so well on my terrible pc and its so fun with a sim wheel mods are great

It's just a really fun game, the car physics and damage are great. I play with damage on maximum as it makes you more conscious about your technique and more tactical in your attacks. The variety of cars tracks and tuning options is more than enough for endless fun and tinkering to get the best beast in it's class.

Eventhough the game is still Pre-Alpha , its already full of fun :) .

I was having a lot of trouble calibrating my brother's Moza wheel to games like Dirt, Forza, Assetto Corsa, and rFactor 2, but Wreckfest was a quick plug-and-play experience that got me straight into the action! I also love that the game is a simcade; I've gotta find more car games in that genre. My family and friends shared the same sentiment when they came over, too. I was enjoying Wreckfest so much that I almost bought the second game, but I stopped myself since I wanted to complete this iteration first and not stack my backlog. Anyways, great game. I plan to build a custom racing sim soon and play this in VR. Not that it's old, but the graphics for this game still hold up. However, I think it's the incredible physics that stand out the most, especially paired with the force feedback (chef's kiss). I hope to someday play with a buddy or two. What a fun game!

Finally bought this and I haven't had this much fun playing a racing game in a very long time. I've been mostly into serious sim racing but this game is just pure distilled fun that takes me right back to my childhood. The devs perfectly captured the ridiculous fun of Flatout. The physics feel great, the visuals are amazing, the career and upgrades are great, and the soundtrack is appropriate and really gives the game that nostalgic 2004 arcade racer vibe. My only criticism is setting up a wheel takes a bit to figure out, I had issues with the car not accelerating and it was because I didn't bind the clutch in the controller settings, which is my bad but some wheel optimization or automatic recognition of the wheel and inputs would be nice. Other than that this is a fantastic game and I highly recommend this to anyone who just wants to have fun.
Great Music, Great Tracks and a Sofa with a V8 Engine - Servers are dead weird to load into and playing with friends is just awkward to do... 8/10
had this game forever, expecting a massive update. Just never came, became repetitive and boring. Don't waste your money on this game.

This game is more than the true heir of Flatout Ultimate Carnage, they kept everything that made people love Flatout and make it even better with new graphics but very well optimized, many fun, crazy, goofy modes and good amount of racing stages to satisfy everyone, no matter you're here for the fun or serious dirt road racing.

Great derby game! The physics make crashes dynamic, so you have to adapt. Fun to progress through the career, though it can be really chaotic. Sometimes frustrating, but also hilarious, the way NPCs will blindly destroy each other, and you. Some races are won just by surviving the carnage until the last lap, and it's really fun.

Apparently unlike most, I am a fan on the latest updates. Playing the dx11 64 bit option, I seem to be getting a pretty decent performance. The new driving physics are welcomed by me too, although more realistic than before, when comparing to other sims such as Assetto Corsa, Wreckfest still leans toward the simcade driving feel. A good mix of the two worlds for me right now.

Obviously the real reason to buy this game is the carnage, and that is what you'll get. Crashing into a huge tyre wall and then watching as they rain around you is a good time in itself, but starting a race with a car and finishing with a motorbike is always hilarious.

I play this game with a g27 wheel. FFB is pretty decent, I can't always feel a lockup, but I can always feel when the front tyres have lost grip. Maybe that is why I can't see the updates being a problem. I have not tried playing with a keyboard but that could be the cause of the recent bad reviews, so would possibly reccomend either a wheel or controller setup to play this.

Not the best, however; Exceptional graphics, car customization, easy tuning, awesome replay feature, fantastic destruction physics, and more tracks than I've seen in any modern racing game. If the developers plan to add more, that would be an added bonus.

After years of dead development at the start - it's back . And the game is not just back alive - it's back with monthly updates. Let's hope it continues like that tho. The updates really make this game a worhfully Flatout successor after all. Which I didn't expect after the first years of release. A lot of things has changed since I tried to play it in the beginning.

The game is mostly based on giving damage to your opponents which makes it super fun. One of the huge changes is the UI, it's so much better, so much more sleek and modern. It also has multiplayer already and single player which is fully based of a career mode. There is A LOT to do in this career.

Vehicles can be bought, tuned, customized. Every edit to your vehcile costs money, which u can make in your career - unless u win it by playing career mode.

If u like to crash other cars, go for it.

pretty fun, its just a racing game. wreckfest has some decent vehicle physics but it shouldn't have been named Wreckfest...cause tis lacking in the wreck department. the damage just isn't there to the extent it should be when it tries to label itself as such. there is an amount of CARnage here but...beamng is far stupid amounts better.

Really the most fun you can have in multiplayer is if you play tag with a friend, the contact timer lets someone always win. The game has excellent graphics and sounds, nice driving physics with A LOT of destruction. Just look at the pics up there, none are edited. At this point the game is not worth the current price so I'd advice you buy it when it is on sale. Can't wait to see how much content this will have, it already has a lot planned.

EDIT: Look at the other reviews about the frequency of updates. Complete bullshit.

EDIT: Have to update my review, as others have mentioned the game took a complete turn somewhere along development. It is quite enjoyable now. I especially like the system they made for purchasing and customizing cars, you can even change liveries, bumbers and wheels!

Probably the most fun you'll have playing a racing game.

I genuinely adore this game. I'm not a huge fan of racers, but there's just something about Bugbear's games that make me love them. The damage you can cause and take, how your cars get beat up as the race progresses and just how gorgeous the games they make are. As it stands the only thing I can count against it is that the multiplayer lobby is skeletal at best in features and that it could do with a bit more optimization, but that's it. The game feels good, racing is fun, derbies are violent and funny, and multiplayer really is where the game truly shines at the moment.

Do remember that this is an early access review though, and the game is missing a lot of features still (like the entire singleplayer campaign), so take that with a grain of salt. :)

At the moment, "Next Car Game" or "Wreckfest" is an insanley fun racer, although a bit lacking in content. As a package right now, it would be hard to recommend the price; however, the game will still undergo lots of updates before fully released so by the time it's finished I have no doubts it will be great.

So far you get
-a tech demo physics playground
-5 cars with customizable parts
-5 (i think) tracks (with a couple variants)
-races vs. AI
-multiplayer
the races against the AI can get boring fairly quick, as there is no campaign or ultimate objective for doing them, but the multiplayer races are a ton of fun. I recommend this game.

this is a perfect example why you should NOT pay for Early Access Game. Lesson learned.

The bad:
- Only a few cars in the base game (seems designed to make you buy their DLC).
- No qualifying means faster cars will often start many places in front of you, making it almost impossible to overtake in the common 3-lap races.
- External camera is rather bad because it doesn't let you see well farther ahead the track.

The good:
- Smashing into opponents and receiving points for it is quite satisfying.
- I personally love the mostly metal music they chose (I even set engine sound to 50% so I can hear the music better).

Conclusion: not worth full price, buy only at discount.

After the long awaited update that completly rebuilt the game's physic/damage engine, Wreckfest is finally back on track. The devs admited a problem with this approach that put updates on hiatis for nearly a year, but things look to progress nicely now. We now have great new physics, a few new cars, a new track (that plays beautifully) and the promise of much more to come.

The one thing the game needs (and is supposed to be comming) is a 'career' mode to keep the solo players happy, otherwise there's little reason to play the same tracks over and over after the initial thrill at how great the play (and damage) is. Loads of fun, but just no longevity until career mode comes along.

Online/server mode (from what the regulars are saying) is a real blast, so there's that for you multi-player guys.

I'll give it a thumb's up with the caviet that we get more car customizability to go along with the proposed career mode.

I was a big fan of the original demolition derby, but sadly somehow missed the flatout series. With that being said, i was eyeballing Wreckfest for a sale and when it went on sale this week, I knew I was gonna bite. I am very glad that I did, this game is a ton of fun. It took me a bit to tweak some settings and get it all dialed in just so, but I am playing off a gaming laptop with a solid i7 and GTX1060 and outputting this to a 48" Sony Bravia 4K and it looks and plays really great. I have not tried with my Thrustmaster wheel yet, I have been using and Xbox one s wireless controller and it works well. This game is very polished and FUN!! as heck. Some of the wrecks and action in this game is stuff you will not find in any other racer and makes me laugh. When you have a close call or a huge crash it is Super Fun to go back and watch the replay, I have only played the game for about 4 hours so far, but for the sale price, I feel like I definitely got my money's worth. If you are thinking about trying this one out, go for it! It's worth the price. Would buy this just for the derby stuff alone let alone the derby racing and special events.

This project isn't abandoned. Go to the Bugbear's Community Forum and you'll see that major progress has been already done. Latest build is very fun to play, especially with force feedback wheel. You really should buy this one, you won't regret it!
